decision: Algeria country-reference research is complete enough for a transparent pre-cascade row. Apply it immediately before adding sealed yassir-algeria corridors; do not run Algeria through Singapore fallback.

captain_usd_yr.source: Regional modeled maritime-wage proxy retained because no strong Algeria maritime-captain salary source was found; acceptable only as labelled draft until local wage source replaces it.

energy_usd_kwh.source: GlobalPetrolPrices Algeria electricity page reports September 2025 business electricity at USD 0.035/kWh, citing CREG, Ministry of Energy and Mines, and Sonelgaz; rounded up to 0.04/kWh for operating conservatism.

grid_co2_kg_kwh.source: Climatiq/ADEME Algeria grid electricity factor is 0.548 kgCO2e/kWh; rounded to 0.55. Source is deprecated but explicit and better than fallback.

marina_overhead_usd_yr.source: Regional modeled marina/port overhead proxy retained; Algeria marina-fee search found weak port/marina leads but no tariff table. Replace before final investment-grade economics if available.

cost_index.source: Regional cost-index proxy; do not present as sourced local statistic.

source_leads.name: Climatiq Algeria grid electricity factor
source_leads.evidence: Search result: electricity supplied from grid — Algeria, factor CO2e 0.548 kg/kWh, ADEME source.

source_leads.name: Numbeo Algeria vs Morocco cost comparison
source_leads.evidence: Search result: Morocco cost of living incl. rent 28.0% higher than Algeria; used only as a low-confidence cost-index lead.

source_leads.evidence: September 2025 Algeria business electricity price USD 0.035/kWh; sources CREG, Ministry of Energy and Mines, and Sonelgaz. Use 0.04/kWh conservative rounded input.

source_leads.name: Climatiq / ADEME Algeria grid electricity factor

apply_gate: Apply this row before any Algeria aggregate run; never allow Singapore fallback.
Keep captain_usd_yr and marina_overhead_usd_yr visibly labelled T4 draft inputs until replaced by local wage/tariff sources.
